title: Carbon Monoxide (CO)
description: Near surface concentration of carbon monoxide (CO) estimated by NASA's GEOS-CF model.

mp4.note: The MP4 starts 24 h after the PNG frames (verified against the burned-in date).

colorbar.note: x1 is exclusive. Pixels 68-69 and 464-465 are a white border. The scale is NOT linear: labels 40/100/130/200/500 sit at x 67/192/285/374/466 (label centres in CO_colorbar.png, +-3 px); values in between are interpolated linearly.

encoding.model: pixel = a(v)*colorbar(v) + (1-a(v))*background, background = greyscale Earth (black ocean)
encoding.note: Opacity measured from PNG frames over ocean, land and ice: ~1 for every value present (CO is never below ~45 ppbv), so the background never shows.

disclaimer: Values are decoded from visualization colours (approximate), not raw science data.
